description: The full text of one help article as Markdown, with links to related articles. Pass the id from help_search, or a keyword: an exact title wins, a keyword several articles share returns them to pick from, anything else gets the best search hit.

keyword.description: Used when no id is given, e.g. "fireball".

lang.description: Answer language: en, ru or ua (uk also accepted). Untranslated text falls back to Russian.

name: help_get
title: Read a DreamLand help article
